ValidationRule.description: Zips for US based leads must be at least 5 digits long
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (LEN( PostalCode ) < 5 && NOT(LEN(PostalCode) = 0)) && ( Country = "United States" || Country = "USA") && (CreatedById = "00580000002puto" || CreatedById = "005800000036e5q")
